title: Best Gyms in Wellington 2026 — CBD, Hutt Valley, and Kapiti
meta_desc: Find the best gyms in Wellington, compare prices and membership options from $15/week
intro: Wellington's gym scene has evolved significantly over the past few years, with new players entering the market and established franchises expanding their footprint. With prices starting from $15 per week, Kiwis have more options than ever before. However, navigating the numerous gyms and contracts can be overwhelming, especially for those new to the city.

sections.heading: Wellington Gym Landscape
sections.body: The city centre is home to a cluster of gyms, including Les Mills, Anytime Fitness, and City Fitness. These gyms cater to a diverse range of fitness enthusiasts, from beginners to seasoned athletes. The Hutt Valley and Kapiti regions also have a growing number of gyms, with options like YMCA and Jetts.

sections.heading: Les Mills vs Alternatives
sections.body: Les Mills is a popular choice among Wellingtonians, with its comprehensive range of group fitness classes and state-of-the-art equipment. However, alternatives like F45 and Orangetheory offer a more specialized and intense workout experience. When it comes to pricing, Les Mills membership starts at $24.95 per week, while F45 and Orangetheory cost around $30-$40 per week.

sections.heading: Hutt Valley and Kapiti Options
sections.body: The Hutt Valley and Kapiti regions have a range of gym options, including Jetts, Snap Fitness, and YMCA. These gyms offer a more affordable and flexible alternative to the city-centre options. For example, Jetts Hutt Valley costs $15 per week, with no contract, while YMCA Kapiti costs $20 per week, with a 6-month contract.
